concept: Corrección batch 1 — Logo horizontal centrado arriba; precio al footer como botón

Only make this change: Two changes. (1) Remove the stacked logo in the top-right corner and instead place a horizontal logo lockup centered at the top: the IRS Protect Plus shield logo on the left, a thin vertical divider, and the Best Vision Accounting logo (emblem plus script name) on the right, side by side, reproduced exactly from the existing logos. (2) Remove the grey line "Desde $19.99 al mes · Hasta $10,000 en representación" from under the headline and place it at the bottom of the image, just above the small disclaimer line, as an eye-catching button: a deep navy-blue (#10193F) rounded pill with white bold text "Desde $19.99 al mes · Hasta $10,000 en representación". All Spanish text must be spelled exactly as written here, with correct accents and punctuation. Do not add any other text.
